[test-api][test-mcp] Fix record/list .test store routing split; aggregate discoverable stores on read

fields.implementation_summary: Added optional workspace param to test_get_spec/test_get_execution/test_list_specs/test_list_executions in test-mcp. When workspace is omitted, reads aggregate across every .test store discoverable from the server workspace root via memory_api::workspace::discover_workspace_store_roots (same policy-aware descendant discovery ticket-api/spec-api/rule-api already use), deduped by id, sort/limit re-applied globally after merge. Explicit workspace still pins to a single store (unchanged single-store resolution via config_for_workspace).

fields.validation_summary: cargo test -p test-mcp (4/4 passed, including new list_executions_aggregates_nested_descendant_store covering aggregation, explicit-workspace pinning, and post-merge sort+limit correctness). cargo build --workspace: clean.
